description: kb ambient surfaces. UserPromptSubmit (kb-pull): score-floored hints naming what the KB holds about this prompt + the rolling session digest. SessionStart (kb-session-start): archive the previous sitting's digest so 'now' stays honest, and cue an unseeded project once. Both fail-open; neither blocks a tool call. The Stop hook (kb-scribe) is RETIRED as of 0.9.0 — its enforcement now ships as the 'session-digest' duty in the turn-end plugin, because two plugins each owning a blocking Stop hook re-armed each other.
